Fleets & business · 6 minute read

Graphics on leased vehicles.

Whether you can put signwriting or a wrap on a lease van, which films remove cleanly, and how to plan removal before the vehicle goes back.

Get a free quote ↗Try the Van Designer ↗

At a glance

1call to your lease company first
2weeks to plan the removal
0permanent changes to the paint

In this guide

  1. Check your lease agreement first
  2. Signwriting or a wrap on a lease van
  3. Planning removal before return
Get a free quote ↗

Quick answer

Usually yes, with your lease company’s agreement. Use removable cast film, keep the paint in good condition and book removal before the return date.

01

Check your lease agreement first

Most lease companies allow removable graphics, but the terms vary. Check your agreement or ask your provider before booking, and keep their answer on file.

Tip

Ask whether they need to approve the design or only be told about it. Some providers have their own requirements.

02

Signwriting or a wrap on a lease van

Usually fine

  • Cut vinyl signwriting
  • Partial wraps in cast film
  • Full wraps on sound factory paint
  • Fleet numbers and decals

Check first

  • Colour changes (DVLA and lease terms)
  • Graphics on glass
  • Vehicles with existing paint damage
  • Short leases ending soon

We use quality removable cast films on lease vehicles, which are designed to come off cleanly from sound factory paint when removed correctly.

03

Planning removal before return

1

Book early

Arrange removal a couple of weeks before the return date.

2

Remove carefully

Heat and slow peeling protect the paint.

3

Clean the residue

Adhesive is cleaned off so the van is ready to hand back.

Peeling it yourself

Pulling cold film can lift paint and leave residue.

Fix: Let us remove it with the right tools.

Leaving it too late

Rushed removal risks return charges.

Fix: Book removal before the return date.

Cheap film

Calendered film can crack and be hard to remove.

Fix: Use removable cast film from the start.

What to have ready for your quote

  • Lease company and agreement terms
  • Lease end date
  • Paint condition
  • Coverage wanted
  • Whether a colour change is planned
  • Photos of the van
  • Who signs off the design
  • Removal date if known

Before you book

Leased vehicle graphics: your questions.

Will graphics affect my lease return?

Removable cast film fitted on sound paint and removed correctly should not. Return charges usually come from damage, residue or rushed removal.

How long does removal take?

It depends on the coverage and the age of the film. Signwriting is quicker than a full wrap. We confirm timings when you book.

Can you remove graphics fitted by someone else?

Yes. We can remove existing graphics before refitting new ones or before the van goes back.
